name: Thai Green Coconut Curry with Shrimp, Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Trim and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add curry paste and salt; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, green
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add bell pepper, broccoli, coconut milk, and broth to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once the curry is simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook until veggies start to soften, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges. Set aside for serving.
When the veggies are softened, add shrimp to the pot. Continue to cook until veggies are tender and shrimp are cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Divide rice and curry between plates or bowls; serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
